purpose: Manages travel pricing records with list, get-by-id, create, update and delete operations

menu_permission.permission_format: {module_code}/{section-slug}/{sub-section-slug}:{flag}; flag is a UserRoleDetailed column (view, add, edit, delete, approve, reject, remarks, close)

endpoints.name: Get All
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve all travel pricing records. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingData, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingActions. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetTravelPricing, GetSectionActions. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]
error_handling.exceptions: Caught and returned as 500 with the exception message (catches: Exception)

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve all travel pricing records
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieve all travel pricing records — calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingData, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingActions
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Invalid token or user not found

endpoints.name: Get Travel Pricing By Id
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve travel pricing by ID. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingById. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid scheduler ID is required [when id <= 0]
error_handling.not_found: 404: Travel pricing not found [when travelpricing == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve travel pricing by ID
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 2 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

endpoints.name: Create Travel Pricing

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; a duplicate check exists so repeating usually fails with a conflict/validation message

endpoints.detailed_description: Create travel pricing. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetModeOfTravelById, ITravelPricing.GetFuelTypeById. Persists changes to: TravelPricing: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 409, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Amount must be greater than zero. [when request.Amount <= 0]; Invalid required fields. [when request.ModeOfTravelId <= 0 || request.TravelTypeId <= 0 || request.AreaCategoryId <= 0 ||]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create travel pricing
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Create travel pricing — validates the request, checks for an existing/duplicate record, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetModeOfTravelById, ITravelPricing.GetFuelTypeById
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type CreateTravelPricingDto (inline); passes 3 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: Amount must be greater than zero.; Invalid required fields.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Amount must be greater than zero.

endpoints.name: Update Travel Pricing

idempotency.notes: Re-sending the same payload sets the same values

endpoints.detailed_description: Update travel pricing. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingById, ITravelPricing.DuplicateCheckAsync. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 409, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid Travel Pricing ID is required. [when travelPricingId <= 0]; At least one field must be provided for update. [when request.Amount <= 0 && request.ModeOfTravelId == 0 && request.TravelTypeId == 0 && request]
error_handling.not_found: 404: Travel pricing not found. [when travelPricing == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to update travel pricing
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Update travel pricing — validates the request, checks for an existing/duplicate record, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingById, ITravelPricing.DuplicateCheckAsync
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) travelPricingId must reference existing record(s); request body of type UpdateTravelPricingDto (inline); passes 4 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: sets travelPricing.amount, travelPricing.mode_of_travel, travelPricing.fuel_type, travelPricing.travel_type, travelPricing.area_category, travelPricing.vehicle_type and saves changes
business_logic.validations: Valid Travel Pricing ID is required.; At least one field must be provided for update.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Valid Travel Pricing ID is required.
At least one field must be provided for update.
validation_rules.when: request.Amount <= 0 && request.ModeOfTravelId == 0 && request.TravelTypeId == 0 && request.AreaCategoryId == 0 && request.JobGradeId == 0 && request.UnitId == 0 && request.FuelTypeId == null && request.VehicleTypeId == null

endpoints.name: Delete Travel Pricing

idempotency.notes: Repeating the call after success will typically return not-found or no change

endpoints.detailed_description: Delete travel pricing. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: TravelPricing: UPDATE, soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid lead ID is required. [when id <= 0]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.not_found: 404: Travel Pricing not found. [when existingTravelPricing == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when current_user == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to delete travel pricing
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Delete travel pricing — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ITravelPricing.GetTravelPricingById, ICommon.ToJsonString, writes an audit log entry
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 3 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: TravelPricing: UPDATE; soft delete (is_deleted flag); AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.side_effects: AuditLog DELETE (Settings > Expense Settings > Travel Pricing)
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
